_note: AI 효과음 제작 목록. 키 이름은 게임의 소리 키(assets/audio/<키>_<번호>.wav)와 같다. 프롬프트는 영어만. 임시값은 시험 생성 후 다듬는다.

defaults.negative: low quality, music, speech, voice, noise, distortion, cartoon, laughing

kinds._note: kind별 선별 기준(want). onset_s: 소리가 시작되는 시점 상한, head_s/head_min: 앞쪽 head_s초 안에 들어 있어야 하는 에너지 비율, events: 허용 소리 덩어리 수 [최소,최대], centroid_hz: 음색 중심 범위 event_rel: 첫 소리 대비 이 비율 이상인 덩어리만 센다(반향은 제외, 기본 0.3).

rifle.prompt: single assault rifle gunshot, close microphone, loud sharp crack, dry with no reverb, realistic sound effect

rifle_far.prompt: distant assault rifle gunshot heard from far away through walls, muffled soft thump with a long echo, realistic sound effect

pistol.prompt: single 9mm pistol gunshot, close microphone, sharp crack, dry with no reverb, realistic sound effect

pistol_far.prompt: distant 9mm pistol gunshot heard from far away through walls, muffled pop with a long echo, realistic sound effect

footstep.prompt: single footstep of a tactical boot on a tile floor indoors, dry foley, realistic sound effect

door.prompt: wooden interior door being opened by hand, creak of hinges and a latch click, dry foley, realistic sound effect

door_ajar.prompt: wooden door pushed slightly open, quiet hinge creak, dry foley, realistic sound effect

kick.prompt: heavy boot kicking open a wooden door, wood cracking and splintering with a loud thud, dry, realistic sound effect

taser.prompt: police taser discharging, rapid electric crackling arc and buzzing, dry, realistic sound effect

reload.prompt: rifle magazine ejected and a new magazine inserted, metal clicks and a bolt slide, dry foley, realistic sound effect

hit.prompt: bullet impact on a human body, dull heavy thud, dry, realistic sound effect

siren.prompt: police siren wailing outdoors in the distance, realistic sound effect

radio.prompt: police radio squelch, short static burst and two beeps, dry, realistic sound effect

heart.prompt: single human heartbeat, deep soft lub dub, dry, realistic sound effect

hum.prompt: quiet empty building interior room tone, faint air conditioning hum, steady and seamless, realistic ambience
